svg.title: SegAgent architecture
svg.desc: A React workspace sends messages and referenced mask IDs to FastAPI. One conversation per case provides history and checkpointed LangGraph state. Typed intent and a dialogue state machine constrain the Qwen3.5-9B planner. Actions include protocol lookup, prompt-normalized VoxTell segmentation in bounded batches, existing-mask inspection, role-aware contour quality control, clarification that resumes the same turn, and visual question answering. Tool evidence returns to planning; a metric-aware grounding verifier and evidence critic guard final answers. Seed protocols, optional guideline text, independent VoxTell inference, file-backed artifacts, JSONL messages and events, and SQLite graph checkpoints support the workflow. Live NDJSON includes thinking_delta and workflow events; a complete answer event delivers the final response. MCP exposes tools; A2A is an auxiliary research adapter. These research checks are not clinical validation.
